sections.name: 点火 / Ignition
sections.intent: Bass-led hook, syncopated palm-muted chord punctuation, sparse melodic answer

sections.name: 铁轨 / Iron Drive
sections.intent: Locked kick-bass, double-tracked chugs, offbeat accents and ghost snare

sections.name: 回声 / Signal Chorus
sections.intent: Open power chords, melodic call-response and wider cymbal movement

sections.name: 裂隙 / Ascending Fault
sections.intent: Syncopated riff variation, upper melody answer, drums build into break

sections.name: 重坠 / Half-Time Descent
sections.intent: Heavy half-time accents with real empty space, darker bass and low toms

sections.name: 重燃 / Rebuild
sections.intent: Rising articulation density, kick doubles, original motif restated

sections.name: 追光 / Lead Flight
sections.intent: Lead solo response with harmony, alternate picking and tom/cymbal variety

sections.name: 终章 / Final Signal
sections.intent: Full-band riff return, twin lead harmony and transition fill into loop
